race.comment: SKIP TO ME LOU (9) sets the standard after a strong second at Albion Park, beaten two metres as the favorite, with early wide work adding merit. His previous fourth came in an NR up to 75, and he boasts a solid track-and-distance record, though the second-row draw is a concern. JAKOB (3) returned with a third at Albion Park in an Up to 1 Lifetime Wins, beaten over 10 metres. He looks poised to improve second-up after a previous Riverina Paceway failure due to breaking stride. SO MANY MOMENTS (10) brings consistent Albion Park form and drops in prizemoney after a third in Mares No NR; she also defeated MAYWYN VALENTINO by 9.6m two starts ago, but the second row after gate one isn't ideal. BART BENTLEY (8) has a chance from a Redcliffe fourth and an Albion Park second in NR up to 70, holding two wins and six places from 14 starts at this track and distance despite his second-row position.
